verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's DGX B200 documentation positions the system for LLM inference, claiming 15X inference performance and naming large language models and chatbots as target workloads. NVIDIA's NIM and NeMo docs describe deploying LLMs, but they are not tied to this part. Neither low-precision formats nor any named serving stack is documented for the B200. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support, documented TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for B200, B200-specific serving guidance, independent hands-on inference corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part

citations.quote: NVIDIA DGX B200 delivers 3X the training performance and 15X the inference performance of previous-generation systems.
DGX B200 can handle diverse workloads—including large language models, recommender systems, and chatbots
